(1) Lemma-1 derivative operators are exact Bernstein coefficient transforms (u/v derivative lowers the axis degree by one, coefficients transform as d*(c[i+1]-c[i])); they are machine-checked against known-derivative fixtures in the in-module unit tests. (2) The normal-numerator assembly `assemble_normal_numerator` computes M = W(Au x Av) - Wv(Au x A) - Wu(A x Av) from the frozen patch nets by exact degree-grown tensor-Bernstein products (binomial-ratio coefficient law), returning the module's own NormalNumerator record (degree + row-major flat R3 grid, width dv+1, the identical shape to the non-constructible frozen patches::MPolynomial, which stays untouched); the conformance test re-verifies the identity Xu x Xv = M/W^3 per fixture by exact evaluation against a DIRECT rational-derivative computation (independent analytic basis-derivative evaluation) on the shared ADM-SHIM fixture kit (bilinear graph, rational biquadratic unit-sphere octant, collapsed-edge quarter cone) plus this packet's genuine-parameter-singularity pinch patch. (3) The hemisphere certificate `hemisphere_certificate`: the SFC float search `midpoint_normal_direction` yields the dyadic direction c; the certificate is the exact outward-rounded interval evaluation of the coefficient-wise dots c*M_ij (min over the coefficient-net lower bounds), and min(bernstein coefficients of c*M) > 0 certifies regular on ALL of the box (convex-hull property); the verdict AND the coefficient net are returned so the caller (who owns subdivision) sees the margin. (4) The per-box normal cone `normal_cone` extracts the anchored cone (admission::NormalCone shape, anchor = the normalized M-value at the box centre = the float midpoint normal) bracketing the normal directions over a box from M's Bernstein hull over that box (hull_bernstein_2d per axis), with the certified sine bound s_up = |n x anchor|_ub / (|n|_lb * |anchor|_lb) required < 1; a coarse or hemisphere-spanning box returns None and the caller subdivides - no sampled normal appears in any certificate. The frozen ADM-SHIM kernels in patches.rs are untouched (still refuse Unfrozen; the ADM-SHIM refusing_kernels_refuse contract test stays green): patches.rs is outside this packet's write_allow, so the L3 bodies land in the new construct::normal_cone module (extend, never edit).
